# Source Role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SourceRole`](gmeow-SourceRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SourceRole>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/citations`](../../slices/citations.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The anti-rigid role of being a source — borne by a [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md) when it is used as evidence for a claim. A thing is only contingently a source; the same work may be evidence for one claim, the subject of another, and a work in its own right. Source-hood is primarily relator-mediated (via [`CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md)), but [`SourceRole`](gmeow-SourceRole.md) provides a named handle when needed.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md), [`gufo:FunctionalComplex`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-functionalcomplex)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SourceRole`](gmeow-SourceRole.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md), [`gufo:FunctionalComplex`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-functionalcomplex). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use (sparingly) when source-hood needs a named handle — to type a [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md) as contingently playing the source role for queries or display — beyond the relator-mediated citation it normally rides on.

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating source-hood as a rigid kind of the work (it is anti-rigid — the same work is also a subject and a work in its own right) and avoid it for the common case, where the citation is fully carried by a [`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md).

### How to use

- Co-type the [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md) with [`gmeow:SourceRole`](gmeow-SourceRole.md) only when a named source handle is needed; otherwise record the source relationship through a [`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md), which is the primary, relator-mediated form.

- ex:parishRegister a [`gmeow:SourceRole`](gmeow-SourceRole.md).
